column3: “on that very day” renders “on this day.”
“indeed obey” renders an emphatic doubled verb, “listening you will listen”; “My own possession” renders “segullah,” a treasured possession.
“a thick cloud” renders “the thickness of the cloud,” and “believe” renders “trust.”
“the border of it” renders “its edge”; “shall surely be put to death” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
NASB adds “a long blast” for the verb “draws out” (the horn sounds long); “surely … shot through” renders doubled verbs.
“trumpet” renders “shofar,” a ram’s horn (also in verse 19).
“grew louder and louder” renders “was going and very strong,” and “with thunder” renders “with a voice.”
